$comment: Copy to ~/.email-hygiene/profile.json and customize. NEVER commit the filled-in copy.

account.$aliases_comment: Other addresses that deliver into THIS mailbox (Outlook.com aliases). Mail addressed to these is direct, not forwarded, so deep_scan will not flag it as an external subscription.

cleanup.$routes_comment: Route wanted-but-noisy senders to their own folder. Still subscribed, just filed. Folder may be nested, e.g. 'Inbox/GitHub'.

purge.$comment: Ongoing deletion of aged mail from senders you already rejected. Runs before cleanup, so noise is deleted rather than filed. Never permanent: mail goes to Deleted Items, recoverable for 30 days.
